name: Mule The
overview: The mule appears in Scripture as a significant beast of burden and transport, often associated with persons of distinction and royal authority, as seen when Solomon was commanded to ride the king's own mule (1 Kings 1:33) and when Absalom rode upon a mule during critical moments (2 Samuel 13:29; 18:9). The origin of the mule is noted in Genesis 36:24, highlighting its early presence and value. Additionally, mules were prized for their strength and utility in carrying burdens and messengers, underscoring their practical importance in biblical times.
